name: Crypto price-level alerts to Telegram (fire once, re-arm)

parameters.content:
## Price level alerts
Cold-start seeds each level silently (already past = fired). Re-arm needs two consecutive safe runs outside the percent-of-level band (`rearmBandPct`, default 0.1%; 0 disables depth only).

Timestamped public Binance data (data-api.binance.vision), no key. Stale data (`maxPriceAgeSec`, default 180) or a failed fetch aborts ALL evaluation with a visible Check error; no alerts or state writes.

Tune offline (u/vlotstroom): pull a few weeks of 1-minute klines from data-api.binance.vision, count re-crosses at different rearmBandPct values, pick the smallest band that kills most churn. No live calibrator.
